# Nailz by Divine

> Private nail studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Gel X, acrylic sets, builder gel, French tips, nail art and luxury jelly pedicures from Divine, a licensed nail tech with her own private suite at Salons on Chisholm in Round Rock. Bring your inspo; she brings it to life.

- Phone: (512) 563-5770
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Hutto, Cedar Park, Brushy Creek
- client rating: 5.0 from 22 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nailzbydivine/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nailzbydivine/book.html

## Services
- Gel X sets: Soft-gel Gel X extensions, from a clean solid colour up to full Tier Four nail art. From $60.
- Acrylic full sets & fills: Short, medium, long and XL acrylic sets in any shape, plus fills and natural-nail overlays. From $55.
- Old School Frenchies: Crisp, classic white-tip French on short square nails, the look her clients keep rebooking. $45.
- Builder gel & manicures: Builder gel with a Russian manicure, polish or design, lotion massage, hot towel and steam. From $65.
- Luxury jelly pedicures: Steamed jelly pedicures in a calm private suite, with gel, Frenchies or acrylic on the toes. From $60.
- Frenchie Combo: Nails and toes: a full set of Gel X or acrylic Frenchies plus a luxury jelly pedicure with French tips. From $135.

## About
Nailz by Divine is Divine Seiler’s own nail studio, in Suite 170 at Salons on Chisholm on Chisholm Trail Rd in Round Rock. It’s one calm room with the NAILZ BY DIVINE letters on a champagne plaster wall, one nail desk, a pedicure chair and one client at a time. Divine studied her craft and is fully licensed. Clients come for Gel X and acrylic sets, Old School Frenchies, builder gel, nail art from florals to Halloween drips, and luxury jelly pedicures, which clients say they rarely find with an independent nail tech. They come back because she listens, takes her time and won’t let you leave with something she doesn’t think is up to par. It’s a small, young, woman-owned business, and her clients are proud to support it. Book online through GlossGenius, or call or text (512) 563-5770.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book with Nailz by Divine?
  A: Book online through Divine’s GlossGenius page and pick any open time, or call or text (512) 563-5770. The studio is open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 5 pm.
- Q: How much is a full set?
  A: Gel X starts at $60 and acrylic full sets start at $55 (short), $65 (medium), $75 (long) and $85 (XL). Nail art is priced in tiers, and the full menu is on the Services page.
- Q: Is there a deposit?
  A: Most services take a small deposit when you book online, from $10 to $30 depending on the service.
- Q: Do you do pedicures?
  A: Yes. Luxury jelly pedicures start at $60 with solid gel, and you can add Frenchies or acrylic on the toes. The Frenchie Combo pairs a full set with a French pedicure.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Suite 170 inside Salons on Chisholm, 1307 Chisholm Trail Rd in Round Rock, TX 78681. It’s a private suite, so you’ll have Divine’s full attention.
- Q: Can I bring a photo of the design I want?
  A: Yes, please do. Clients say Divine brings their inspo to life, from French tips to full nail art.
